releaseNotes.content:
## V26.2.2

- Added Xicoy Basic, Extended and Maximum modes with AppID auto-bind.
- Added Enjet DTA auto-bind and multi-ECU status support.
- Added radio THR, ECU THR, Heli/TP RPM and Xicoy Fuel Level After Restart.
- Added configurable FlameOut and Restart status alarms.
- Preserved the validated telemetry-only Lua source.
